morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic sector sees gas price relief amid export volatility and cost shocks.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic industry received a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices dropping from Rs 82 following representations.
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed despite a generally weak export outlook.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore and posted a Q2 2026 sales and profit beat.
stress_signals: Overall export outlook remains weak for the cluster with reports citing an alleged 50% decline in exports [c2b4a2f5422a, c2e1d2a72338].
A large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered inside a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53].
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices received a Rs 5 discount following industry representations [279312659941].
Kajaria Ceramics reported a Q2 2026 sales and profit beat [83abd2d67eca] and invested in solar energy [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Monitor sustainability of the Rs 5 natural gas discount and final pricing structures.
Track actual recovery and shipment volumes of ceramic exports to Gulf destinations.
Observe account-level liquidity, inventory levels, and repayment track records for units in Rafaleshwar GIDC.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces mixed trends with textile power/labor disruptions and diamond sector pressures.
what_changed: Surat textile mills faced power cuts, electricity cost hikes, and a fire incident in Pandesara causing Rs 1 crore in losses [385f9b90ae46, dba1533f8fd5].
ICA GemLab was launched in Surat for international-grade diamond and jewelry testing [4b0e420193b2].
Surat textile traders recovered Rs 6 crore in stuck mercantile payments, while a mill owner was defrauded of Rs 1.69 crore [a523a4bf860d, 25d6a0f6dbec].
stress_signals: Surat textile units are bracing for potential fresh labor unrest and agitations following August stir [d1fffb80f879].
US demand slump impacted diamond and apparel exporters, leading to dried-up orders and factory closures [caa34a6cf84e].
A Surat diamond unit shut down with the owner untraceable and workers raising grievances over unpaid salaries [8cfd5e03a794].
improvement_signals: Surat's diamond industry is seeing a revival driven by strong global demand ahead of Diwali [01cb30b63e0d].
MANTRA converted Surat textile hotfix waste into construction material and is exploring technical textile collaboration with Mercedes-Benz [da1ef316cd6d, 3a4ce1852d7c].
The trade chamber inaugurated Textile Week-1 at Sarsana exhibition centre for commercial engagement [bc924716a59a].
what_to_watch: Monitor borrower accounts for impacts from potential labor agitations and power cost hikes in textile units [d1fffb80f879, 385f9b90ae46].
Track pre-Diwali liquidity, bonus disbursements, and worker wage payments across diamond units [c8a89bd2019b].
Assess export credit performance and US demand recovery indicators for diamond and apparel exporters [caa34a6cf84e].
